rationale: The phone was accidentally damaged by water during the covered trip, and the repair report says it cannot be economically repaired, so it falls under Baggage and Personal Effects (wording section 5). It was on a shelf in the customer's own hotel shower, within his sight and reach, so it was attended, and no exclusion applies. Under section 10 and manual section 6 the eligible amount is the $150 Economy per-item limit (no Electronics Plus add-on), less the $100 Economy deductible, giving $50.
